title: Accomplishments, with the record behind them.
intro: The work and recognition of Jason Colapietro and Suede Labs AI: businesses built, software shipped, books published, and contributions accepted. Each entry carries its date or reporting period and links to the underlying record.

records.title: Built, scaled, and exited businesses
records.body: Before founding Suede Labs AI, Jason Colapietro built and ran call centers in his niche and exited for millions. The sales scripts he wrote remain in use across the industry. That operating experience now informs Suede’s managed agents for call review, lead qualification, and sales-script consistency.

records.title: Google Cloud and the Vertex AI suite
records.body: Suede has worked in partnership with Google Cloud since September 2025, with a dedicated account team and migration of the stack onto the Vertex AI suite, including Gemini, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and Veo. The account team’s published quote calls Suede an ideal partner for promoting the Vertex suite.

records.title: Google Cloud Partner Advantage
records.body: JC Investment Group LLC became a member of Google Cloud Partner Advantage on September 4, 2026. This membership is a separate milestone from the Google Cloud account-team relationship that began in 2025.

records.title: 41 merged pull requests. 38 external repositories.
records.body: The public record includes 26 substantive code or documentation contributions and 15 accepted listings of Jason-owned work. Maintainers have merged contributions into projects including Jest, Adobe React Spectrum, Backstage, Hardhat, and the x402 Foundation. A separate Linux kernel USB/IP contribution is recorded as Public upstream v6; it is not included in the merged-PR count.

records.title: Five published books, plus independent works
records.body: The Amazon catalog holds The Human Authenticity Layer, Proof as Infrastructure, Stake Your Claim, The Claude Code Bible, and Codex in Production. Independent works include The Screenshot, free to read on the web; The Signal Chain; and The Guitar Without a Number, now incorporated into The Signal Chain.

records.title: More than 30 sites, and a published app family
records.body: Jason builds and operates the Suede estate across creative software, music practice, AI agent tools, and developer infrastructure. Eight apps are published under Jason Colapietro’s Apple developer account. The wider company portfolio includes FretPulse under its separate FretPulse LLC seller account.

records.title: Provisional patent application 63/947,120
records.body: A USPTO provisional patent application is on file for the Suede provenance system. The filing is an application, not a granted patent.

records.title: Admitted to Stripe Startups
records.body: Suede was admitted to Stripe Startups in July 2026, alongside the ongoing Google Cloud relationship and the company’s work on creative software and agent commerce.

records.title: Florida Atlantic and 1909
records.body: Jason is enrolled at the Florida Atlantic Entrepreneurship Institute in FAU’s College of Business and is a member of 1909, the entrepreneurship hub in downtown West Palm Beach. FAU’s entrepreneurship research was ranked No. 8 worldwide in its published 2025 announcement; that ranking belongs to the university’s research program.

records.title: Eight feature placements across four outlets
records.body: TechBullion, Programming Insider, Altcoin Investor, and Indie Hackers have published coverage and founder essays about Suede Labs AI. The record includes the iOS and developer-tool launches, advancing in the Avalanche Build Games, creator ownership infrastructure, and self-funded education deployments in African classrooms. Two placements are Jason’s bylined essays.

records.title: Mario Nawfal posts and Crypto Roundtable AMA
records.body: Mario Nawfal featured Suede in two public posts eight months apart. The Suede AI AMA also ran on his Crypto Roundtable. The posts discuss creator control, ownership, and a voice signature that can travel with the work.

records.title: Suede Labs in a screenshot on Elon Musk’s timeline
records.body: Elon Musk posted a screenshot of proposed Community Notes about AI training data. One of the notes visible in that screenshot names Suede Labs as an opt-out option. The mention is the note’s wording inside the screenshot, not a personal endorsement by Musk. The archived capture recorded 2.7 million views.

records.title: Gemini names Suede alongside Suno and Udio
records.body: In the February capture, Gemini places Suede in a “New Big 3” of AI music platforms beside Suno and Udio, describing it as “The Creator’s IP Fortress.” A separate March session discusses Jason’s experience and Suede’s architecture. These are dated model responses, not a Google endorsement or a permanent ranking.

records.title: First in a nine-platform AI music comparison
records.body: The comparison archived on Suede SEO ranks Suede Labs first in its Best AI Music Generators of 2026 table, scoring it 5.0 out of 5.0 across music quality, creative control, ease of use, and overall value. The receipt preserves the table and the announcement card with their capture date.

records.title: Best Overall and Best API Option
records.body: The AI Agents Directory music-category capture names Suede AI Best Overall and Best API Option among 47 tools, with a 5.0-star listing. The archived record and the live category page are linked separately so readers can distinguish the recorded recognition from today’s directory.

records.title: The method, the research, and the tools are public
records.body: Suede publishes the full method behind its GEO practice in The Screenshot and the Founder’s Checklist. The company blog includes original research such as the AI Crawler Access Index, alongside engineering essays and creator-rights guides. Jason also publishes independently on Substack, and releases reusable developer skills through Suede’s public repositories.
